link.52d033098b03.source: A single ReAct loop keeps every instruction and observation in one history, so earlier evidence competes with each new tool result. Eventually the history itself becomes part of the problem.
link.52d033098b03.value: 單個 ReAct 迴圈將所有指令和觀察結果儲存在同一段歷史記錄中，因此早期證據會與每項新的工具結果爭奪注意力。最終，歷史記錄本身也會成為問題的一部分。

link.d0cca664a071.source: The implementation cells use the vendored browser bundle. They import the exact same-origin bundle recorded in the browser dependency inventory. CI blocks publication when the bundle, lock, license evidence, or source references drift.

rich.0c19fe0191c3.source: Overflow: evidence and tool output exceed the context window.
rich.0c19fe0191c3.value: 溢位：證據和工具輸出超出上下文視窗的容量。

rich.107e751aefb5.source: Index workflow. The developer defines the pipeline, and generation receives the bounded retrieval bundle from Part B.
rich.107e751aefb5.value: 索引工作流程。開發者定義工作流程，生成階段接收 B 部分提供的有界檢索資料包。

rich.1d95f1a4d89d.source: Each sub-agent receives one task in a fresh context that excludes the histories of other branches.
rich.1d95f1a4d89d.value: 每個子代理程式都會在一個全新的上下文中接收一項任務，其中不包含其他分支的歷史記錄。

rich.399ca1dfd1a0.source: The orchestrator turns the question into independent tasks, making the intended scope inspectable before work begins.
rich.399ca1dfd1a0.value: 編排器將問題拆分成相互獨立的任務，使預定範圍在工作開始前即可檢查。

rich.ab1589a219d9.source: A deep research agent applies the same idea to a question whose evidence would outgrow one conversation. At run time, a planner chooses independent branches and gives each worker only the original question, its assigned task, and the tools it needs. Sibling histories stay outside. A final stage synthesizes the evidence that the workers preserve. Run the pattern first, then inspect its implementation.
rich.ab1589a219d9.value: 深度研究代理程式將同一思路應用於證據規模會超出單次對話容量的問題。執行階段，planner 會選擇相互獨立的分支，並且只向每個工作代理程式提供原始問題、分配給它的任務及其所需工具。同級分支的歷史記錄不會傳入。最後一個階段會綜合各工作代理程式保留的證據。請先執行這一模式，再檢查其實現方式。

rich.accbd97f329f.source: Fresh context is not a sandbox. Context isolation separates the branches' reasoning, while a sandbox limits operating-system access. The browser artifact below has no shell; the later hand-rolled example uses an in-memory filesystem to make shared state visible.
rich.accbd97f329f.value: 全新上下文並不是沙盒。上下文隔離用於分離各分支的推理，而沙盒用於限制對作業系統的存取。下方的瀏覽器製品無法使用 shell；後續的手工實現示例則使用記憶體檔案系統，讓共享狀態清晰可見。

rich.bbceda02ffff.source: .invoke() returns a complete message; .stream() yields partial messages. Both satisfy LangChain's Runnable interface.
rich.bbceda02ffff.value: .invoke() 傳回完整訊息；.stream() 逐步生成部分訊息。兩者都符合 LangChain 的Runnable介面。

rich.bd11436ddff6.source: Deep-research workflow. The planner creates branches at run time. Workers receive task-specific context and store evidence for synthesis.
rich.bd11436ddff6.value: 深度研究工作流程。planner 在執行階段建立分支。工作代理程式接收特定任務的上下文，並儲存證據以供綜合。

rich.c09d3111a382.source: createReactAgent({llm, tools}) turns the Module 1 ReAct loop into explicit model and tool nodes. The compiled graph can run alone or become one node inside a larger workflow.
rich.c09d3111a382.value: createReactAgent({llm, tools}) 將模組 1 的 ReAct 迴圈轉換為顯式的模型節點和工具節點。編譯後的圖既可獨立執行，也可作為更大工作流程中的一個節點。

rich.d8581f2389e1.source: Workers write findings to a shared virtual filesystem, where evidence survives after their contexts end.
rich.d8581f2389e1.value: 工作代理程式將研究結果寫入共享的虛擬檔案系統，這樣即使其上下文結束，證據仍會保留下來。

rich.db7ec90a3c56.source: ChatOpenAI wraps any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The cell reads the active URL and credential from helpers.getConfig(), so the rest of the graph does not depend on where the model runs.
rich.db7ec90a3c56.value: ChatOpenAI 可封裝任何與 OpenAI 相容的 API 端點。該單元格從 helpers.getConfig() 讀取當前的 URL 和憑證，因此圖的其餘部分不依賴模型的執行位置。

rich.fa1ba25e8462.value: 干擾：一個分支的推理會分散下一個分支的注意力。

text.df212abca285.source:
Ask a research question and watch the agent create branches that run in
    parallel across curated external materials and this course before writing one cited answer.
    Each worker streams into its own focusable panel, so you can inspect active
    operations instead of waiting for the entire fan-out to finish.
text.df212abca285.value: 提出一個研究問題，觀察代理程式如何建立多個分支，並行研究精選的外部資料和本課程內容，然後撰寫一份帶引用的統一答案。每個工作代理程式都會將輸出流式傳送到各自可聚焦的面板中，因此可以檢查正在執行的操作，無須等待所有並行分支全部完成。

text.fd931a382a24.source:
Module 2 treats workflow scope as a control surface. Part A introduced a
      harness that decides what context crosses each boundary, what can branch,
      and how results move through a pipeline. Part B applied that control to a
      developer-defined retrieval pipeline and its bounded context bundle.
text.fd931a382a24.value: 模組 2 將工作流程範圍視為一個控制面。A 部分介紹了一套執行框架，用於決定哪些上下文可以跨越各個邊界、哪些任務可以分支，以及結果如何在工作流程中傳遞。B 部分將這種控制應用於開發者定義的檢索工作流程及其有界上下文包。
